title: Chase County Nebraska deputy sees 30-50 drones and mothership

tellings.quote: Reports from Colorado indicate that drones were not flying as a group or pack, but as a single unit. Chase County, Nebraska sheriff deputy reported observing 30 to 50

plain: Around 2019 and 2020, a sheriff's deputy in Chase County, Nebraska, reported seeing 30 to 50 drones along with a "mothership", a larger craft, while reports from Colorado said the drones flew not as a pack but as a single unit. Marik von Rennenkampff reads this out on the show from reports, with the account tied to a man named Doug Johnson. If true, coordinated unexplained craft were flying over the American plains.
